mapper.sql: t.tmpr_asgn_id AS id,t.need_id,t.dev_id,t.bgn_ym, AS end_ym, t.mm_qty AS mth_mm_qty,t.tmpr_asgn_src_cd,t.mtch_scr,t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd AS status,t.asgn_id
FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id
mapper.select: SELECT oppt_id FROM bsn.oppt_need WHERE need_id=#{needId}
SELECT oppt_stts_cd FROM bsn.oppt WHERE oppt_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT need_id,oppt_id,use_yn FROM bsn.oppt_need WHERE need_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT dev_id FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' FOR UPDATE

WITH grades AS (SELECT dtl_cd,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd) AS position FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id='GRADE' AND use_yn='Y') SELECT CAST( CASE WHEN d.main_job_cd=n.job_cd OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_sub_job j WHERE j.dev_id=d.dev_id AND j.job_cd=n.job_cd) THEN 40 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN d.grd_cd=n.grd_cd THEN 20 WHEN abs(dg.position-ng.position)=1 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE greatest(0,(extract(year FROM to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM'))::int-extract(year FROM a.end_dt)::int)*12 +extract(month FROM to_date(n.bgn_ym,'YYYY-MM'))::int-extract(month FROM a.end_dt)::int-1) WHEN 0 THEN 25 WHEN 1 THEN 15 WHEN 2 THEN 8 WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN p.cust_ptnr_id=o.cust_ptnr_id THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.win_prblt_rt >= 60 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(6,2)) FROM bsn.oppt_need n JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=#{dev_id} JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.end_dt,x.prj_id FROM asgn.asgn x WHERE x.dev_id=d.dev_id AND x.asgn_stts_cd IN ('ACTIVE','REPLACED') ORDER BY x.end_dt DESC,x.asgn_id ASC LIMIT 1) a ON true JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN grades dg ON dg.dtl_cd=d.grd_cd LEFT JOIN grades ng ON ng.dtl_cd=n.grd_cd WHERE n.need_id=#{need_id}
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.tmpr_asgn SET tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='RELEASED',updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tmpr_asgn_id=#{id} AND tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: WITH months AS (SELECT to_char(m,'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM generate_series( to_date(#{bgn_ym},'YYYY-MM'),to_date(#{end_ym},'YYYY-MM'),interval '1 month') m), active AS (SELECT t.*, AS effective_end WHERE t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'), totals AS (SELECT m.month, coalesce((SELECT sum(x.mm_qty) FROM asgn.asgn_mth x JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=x.asgn_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND x.work_ym=m.month),0) +coalesce((SELECT sum(t.mm_qty) FROM active t WHERE t.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND t.bgn_ym <= m.month AND t.effective_end >= m.month),0) AS total FROM months m) SELECT message FROM ( SELECT month||' 확정+가배정 MM '||to_char(total,'FM999990.00')||' (1.00 초과)' AS message FROM totals WHERE total > 1 UNION ALL SELECT '다른 필요 인력과 가배정 기간이 겹칩니다.' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active t WHERE t.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND t.tmpr_asgn_id!=#{id} AND t.bgn_ym <= #{end_ym} AND t.effective_end >= #{bgn_ym}) UNION ALL SELECT '필요 인원을 초과한 가배정입니다.' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM months m JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=#{need_id} WHERE (SELECT count(DISTINCT t.dev_id) FROM active t WHERE t.need_id=n.need_id AND t.bgn_ym <= m.month AND t.effective_end >= m.month) > n.psn_cnt) UNION ALL SELECT '퇴사 기간 가배정입니다.' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND d.rsgn_dt < (to_date(#{end_ym},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND h.work_stts_cd='RESIGN' AND h.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{end_ym},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month')) UNION ALL SELECT '휴직 기간 가배정입니다.' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=#{dev_id} AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt < (to_date(#{end_ym},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >= to_date(#{bgn_ym},'YYYY-MM'))) ) notices WHERE #{status}='ACTIVE' ORDER BY message
